hero.subtitle: CSI structural analysis and design software including ETABS, SAP2000, and SAFE.

paragraphs: Aptus Infotech supplies CSI software for structural engineers — ETABS for buildings, SAP2000 for general structures, and SAFE for slab and foundation design. Genuine licenses with local technical support.

items.title: ETABS
items.body: Building analysis and design for multi-story structures.

items.title: SAP2000
items.body: General-purpose FEA for bridges, tanks, and special structures.

items.title: SAFE
items.body: Slab, mat foundation, and transfer slab design and detailing.

items.title: Code Compliance
